description: Searches Google Jobs, which collects postings from many job sites, and returns up to 20 jobs from the first page (title, company, location, via, details, apply_url). Put role and place in the query, e.g. "data engineer jobs in Austin". It does not return full job descriptions or people profiles; for LinkedIn listings with LinkedIn filters use search_linkedin_jobs. A search with no matches is charged; errors are not. Required: query.

country.description: Two-letter country code that localizes the jobs, e.g. "us" or "gb". Omit for the source default, us.

language.description: Language or locale code, 2-20 characters, e.g. "en" or "en_us". Omit for the source default, en_us.

query.description: Job search text with role and place, 1-500 characters, e.g. "data engineer jobs in Austin".

results.description: Maximum jobs returned, integer 1-20, default 10, e.g. 5.

name: search_jobs
title: Search Jobs
